units.source_text: “哥哥，你瞧瞧那枫树树干上的紫花地丁。”

en.t: Brother, look at the violets on the trunk of that maple tree.

units.source_text: 真一用手指着说，“有两株吧。

en.t: Shinichi said, pointing with his finger, There are two plants, aren't there?

units.source_text: 千重子小姐早在几年前就把那两株紫花地丁看作一对可爱的恋人……

en.t: Miss Chieko had already seen those two violets, years before, as a pair of lovely lovers...

units.source_text: 但它们俩却是咫尺天涯啊……”

en.t: But the two of them are so near, and yet so far apart...
